summary: Flow view DONE & live (graph.html static, no daemon restart). Added third toggle DAG|Cloud|Flow. renderFlow(d) uses dagre 0.8.5 (CDN) for standard Sugiyama layered layout: rankdir LR, crossing-minimized, nodes as status-colored cards (left bar = status color, title + status/agent line), edges as d3 curveBasis paths with arrowheads (blocking gray solid / context teal dashed), d3.zoom pan+zoom with first-fit-to-width then preserved. KEY DECLUTTER: only degree>0 connected nodes go into the dagre graph; degree-0 standalone tasks render in a separate collapsible 'Independent' tray (renderFlowOrphans) as compact status-dot chips grouped by recency bucket (Today/This week/This month/Older) when firstSeen/lastChanged are present, else grouped by status — degrades gracefully (currently status, since live daemon still serves null timestamps). flowgraph hidden when no chains exist. setView generalized to 3 views; tick() dispatches flow; resize re-fits. Existing DAG + Cloud untouched. Verified: node --check SYNTAX OK; curl /graph confirms renderFlow + data-view=flow + dagre script present; dagre CDN 200. Not browser-screenshot-verified (MCP Chrome can't reach the IPv4-only :8787). User: hard-reload + click Flow. Time-bucketed tray + any time features still await the one-time daemon restart to activate timestamps.
